notes:
Account summary:
- SMB startup building an AI-first helpdesk assistant used by mid-market customers.
- Found us through blog + quickstart; already integrated SDK in staging.

Procurement / Billing discussion (primary reason in discovery):
- Prefers self-serve hosted API (public cloud). Default preference: pay by corporate credit card to keep POC fast.
- May need invoice for annual plan later; CFO asks for purchase order if ARR grows.
- As a VC-backed startup, asked about startup discount and extension of free credits: 'If we can get at least 60-90 day credits we can prove retention to CFO and convert to a card/invoice.'
- Wants clarity on how to switch from card billing to invoice without downtime or API key rotation.

POC / Technical requirements:
- Primary workloads: chat-based support agent (short-turn conversations), embeddings-backed search across ~50k docs, summarization of long tickets.
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms for generation in chat flows, cold-embeddings batch throughput ~60 req/s, embedding p99 < 300ms when batched (they expect batching for embeddings).
- Throughput: peak ~20-30 concurrent chat sessions during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Want guidance on batching and prefix caching. Will consider quantized models if quality acceptable.
- Model preference: prefer open-ish models and Redwood-verified lower-cost variants for production; will test high-quality variant for NLU during POC. Need routing/fallback to smaller models when quota limits hit.

Security & Compliance:
- Started SOC2-related questionnaire. Need audit logging and retention controls (90 days initially). SSO/SAML slated for Q3 but not blocking POC.

Quotes / Rep notes:
- From CTO: 'Speed of onboarding > raw model quality for this stage. We need straightforward billing and an extension on free credits to run a 30-60 day POC.'
- From Head of Ops: 'If switching to invoice is painful we will likely stay on card until we cross the ARR threshold.'

Open items / Next steps:
- AE (Maya) to confirm startup discount eligibility and required paperwork (due 2026-03-15).
- SE (Jordan) to provide recommended config: batching, KV caching, model variant matrix by cost/latency by 2026-03-14.
- Legal to confirm simple invoice flow and PO acceptance for SMBs (expected timeline 2 weeks).
- Offer: propose 30-day free credits extension + optional 60-day runway if we see early usage signals. Need AE approval to credit account.

Suggested POC success metrics (for internal tracking):
- First-week: embed indexing pipeline up, canonical search recall > 0.75 on test queries.
- Week 2-4: chat p95 latency <250ms, CSAT lift +6% in a 2-week A/B.
- Conversion trigger: sustained monthly usage > $1,200 and positive CSAT delta, then move to paid card billing or small invoice.

Misc links: pricing proposal in Drive, Fireflies transcript, Jira ticket for SOC2 items.
notes_short: Inbound SMB self-serve lead. Wants hosted API, prefers credit card but may require invoice later. Needs startup discount + free credits extension for 30-60 day POC. Security questionnaire started. SE to deliver config recommendations.
